briefs.headline: Using Threads
briefs.body: Threads records the rules you discover through play. Open it with the shown key, M by default. Select Lessons to read the survival instructions available from the start.

briefs.headline: Checking Survival Meters
briefs.body: Survival meters fade when their values are stable. Hold Sneak to show all managed meters and check your condition.
briefs.action: Hold Sneak to check your meters.

briefs.headline: Drinking Safe Water
briefs.body: Water at purity level 3 is safe to drink. Collect rain, melt snow near a campfire, and carry drinking water in bottles. Bottles can go in Curios slots.
briefs.action: Prepare safe drinking water before traveling.

briefs.headline: Balancing Nutrition
briefs.body: Hunger and nutrition are separate. Nutrition tracks six food groups over time. Check each group and choose foods that replenish the lowest ones.
briefs.action: Open nutrition and check your lowest groups.

briefs.headline: Increasing Maximum Health
briefs.body: Eating enough different foods permanently increases your maximum health. Try foods you have not eaten before as well as foods that replenish your nutrition.
briefs.action: Try a food you have never eaten.

briefs.headline: Sugar and Alcohol
briefs.body: Sugar increases speed but makes nutrition drain faster and causes a crash afterward. Moderate alcohol improves control; higher amounts cause impairment.
briefs.action: Check your nutrition before consuming sugar.

briefs.headline: Managing Body Temperature
briefs.body: Your body temperature differs from the temperature around you. Clothing, shelter, biome, season, and food temperature affect it. Prepare for hot or cold areas before traveling.
briefs.action: Bring clothing suited to your destination.

briefs.headline: Movement Controls
briefs.body: Advanced movement uses stamina. Fast run uses Shift, vault uses Mouse 5, and direct dodge uses R; directional double-tap dodging is disabled.
briefs.action: Practice these movements on safe ground.

briefs.headline: Sleeping Safely
briefs.body: Sleep speeds up the passing hours. Weather, temperature, ecology, and active threats continue during sleep. Check the area before using a bed.

briefs.headline: Death’s Door Is Survivable
briefs.body: The hit that takes positive HP to zero leaves you at Death’s Door and adds an injury. You can still move and act. Healing is briefly locked; further hits can kill. Once healing becomes available, restore HP to regain its buffer.
briefs.action: Find safety, then open Body from your inventory.

briefs.headline: Healing and Treatment Are Separate
briefs.body: Restoring HP leaves injuries in place. Open Body to match medicine to the injury type; each finished treatment removes one injury. Repeated hits add trauma and amplify existing movement, arm, and torso penalties. Trauma expires; injuries need treatment.
briefs.action: Open Body and select an injury to treat.

briefs.headline: Spending Life Points
briefs.body: Life stat choices are permanent for your current life and reset on death. Constitution reduces hunger, thirst, and stamina use. Review each stat before spending points.
briefs.action: Review the effects before applying your points.

briefs.headline: Seasonal Farming
briefs.body: Seasons affect which crops and trees grow well. Check seasonal feedback before planting, and store surplus food for less productive seasons.
briefs.action: Plant crops suited to the current season.

briefs.headline: Preparing for Storms
briefs.body: Storms move through the world and can damage exposed areas. Watch for worsening weather and keep a route to shelter.
briefs.action: Reach shelter before a severe storm arrives.

briefs.headline: Managing Pollution
briefs.body: Pollution spreads and can harm living things. Use detectors and protective equipment, route emissions through chimneys and filters, and clean contaminated areas.

briefs.headline: Supporting Buildings
briefs.body: Buildings need support through foundations, walls, and columns. Add supports as you extend a span or platform.
briefs.action: Add supports before extending a platform.

briefs.headline: Pillager Assault Warnings
briefs.body: Pillager scouts appear more often than full assaults. Assaults are announced in advance. Use the warning to gather allies, fortify approaches, and reach shelter.
briefs.action: Prepare defenses when an assault is announced.
